component.name: socxen
component.description: socxen — agentic SOC analyst skill suite. Investigates and triages Exabeam New-Scale alerts and cases through the Exabeam MCP: evidence gathering, entity pivots, threat/false-positive verdict, and action — with containment recommended for human approval and dismiss/close gated by the host agent's tool-approval rules.

externalReferences.comment: The software bill of materials for the same release — the bridge's full locked dependency tree with artifact hashes (security/gen_sbom.py)

properties.name: ai:containmentCapability
properties.value: none — recommend-only, performed by a human in EDR/IAM

properties.name: ai:guardrails
properties.value: permission tiers 19 allow / 6 ask / 76 deny (settings.snippet.json) + in-prompt ask-before-close backstop

properties.name: ai:secretsHandling
properties.value: Exabeam OAuth key/secret from ~/.exabeam-mcp.env; never logged

components.name: Claude (Anthropic)
components.description: Foundation model the skill runs on. Hosted API — weights are not distributed with socxen. The specific member (e.g. Opus / Sonnet) is selected at runtime by Claude Code, not pinned by socxen.

components.name: soc-investigate methodology (system prompt + reference corpus)
components.description: The agent's instructions: SKILL.md (investigation methodology, governance, output discipline) plus reference/ (tool map, EQL search cookbook, enrichment playbook, report template, triage taxonomy, containment list, worked examples). This prompt corpus — not a model — is the primary AI artifact socxen ships.

properties.name: ai:untrustedInputHandling
properties.value: treats tool output (alerts/events/case notes) as data, never instructions

components.name: exabeam-mcp-bridge
components.description: Bundled local stdio MCP connector (plugin/connector/exabeam-mcp-bridge.py). Forwards to the remote Exabeam New-Scale MCP and auto-refreshes the OAuth token. Read-through; handles the API key/secret.

components.name: mcp
components.description: Connector dependency (mcp>=1.0,<2), resolved by uv at runtime (PEP 723).

components.name: httpx
components.description: Connector dependency (httpx>=0.27,<1), resolved by uv at runtime (PEP 723).

components.name: certifi
components.description: Connector dependency (certifi>=2024,<2027), resolved by uv at runtime (PEP 723).

components.name: observra
components.description: Connector dependency (observra>=1.1,<2), resolved by uv at runtime (PEP 723).

components.name: typing_extensions
components.description: Connector dependency (typing_extensions>=4.7,<5), resolved by uv at runtime (PEP 723).

services.name: Exabeam New-Scale MCP
services.description: External tool surface reached through the bundled connector: 23 tools (Threat Center, Search, detection rules, context tables) and NO containment capability. Registered via plugin/.mcp.json as a bundled MCP server.

properties.name: mcp:toolCountBasis
properties.value: tools the live MCP exposes per tool-map.md; names denied ahead of exposure excluded
